facts.summary: Priced $30M equity offering with warrants, plus BLA delay from device manufacturing issue · Phase 1/2 complete · INO-3107 in recurrent respiratory papillomatosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: We are offering 10,000,000 shares of our common stock, par value $0.001 per share, accompanied by warrants to purchase an aggregate of 10,000,000 shares of our common stock
evidence.safety: INO-3107 was well tolerated in the trial. Of the 32 patients in the trial, 13 patients (41%) reported a treatment-related adverse event, with none greater than Grade 2 severity.
